nodes.name: batch.rs
nodes.summary: Runs the per-account inner loop of L3 memory consolidation: for each pending learning it short-circuits on hash-reinforcement, recalls candidate learnings (embedding or manifest mode), asks the LLM for an ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NONE decision, and applies the resulting state transition.
nodes.languageNotes: Resolves embedding vs manifest recall mode once per batch by probing the embedding provider, so all rows in a batch share one candidate-shortlisting strategy.

nodes.name: decision.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the mem0-style LLM prompt used to decide whether a new learning should be added, merged into an existing one, deleted, or ignored, then parses and fuzzy-corrects the JSON response against the candidate ID set.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a capped Levenshtein distance to fuzzy-match a hallucinated candidate ID back to a real one, guarding against LLM ID drift.

nodes.name: entry.rs
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the consolidation engine: loads pending learnings for a scope, groups them by billing account, resolves a provider/embedding mode per group, and drives consolidate_batch while recording a consolidation_runs ledger row.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: State-machine that applies a resolved consolidation decision (Add/Update/Delete/None) to the learnings store and tallies EventCounts for the run summary.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the L3 consolidation engine that documents the drain-and-decide flow and re-exports the public surface (consolidate, EventCounts, spawn_consolidation_tick, ConsolidationTrigger) from its private submodules.

nodes.name: recall.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the two candidate-recall strategies used before an LLM decision: embedding similarity search (Mode A) and manifest/salience-ranked keyword shortlisting (Mode B).

nodes.name: tests_support.rs
nodes.summary: Test-only helpers that spin up an in-memory SQLite connection with the learnings/session schema and construct PendingLearning fixtures for consolidation unit tests.

nodes.name: tick.rs
nodes.summary: Spawns a dedicated background thread with its own single-threaded Tokio runtime that periodically evaluates consolidation triggers across scopes and runs consolidation ticks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a process-wide AtomicBool guard to ensure spawn_consolidation_tick only starts the background thread once.

nodes.name: triggers.rs
nodes.summary: Policy functions deciding whether a consolidation run should fire: lazy (pending-count + time threshold), forced (manual/any pending), and idle (session gap heuristics), plus an e2e-test scope guard.

nodes.name: abandon_after_consolidation_failure
nodes.summary: Marks a pending learning as abandoned and records the failure reason when a batch aborts due to a capacity error.

nodes.name: consolidate_batch
nodes.summary: Iterates every pending learning in a batch, recalling candidates, requesting an LLM decision via side_query_typed, and applying the resulting event, aborting early on capacity errors.

nodes.name: resolve_batch_provider_info
nodes.summary: Determines the LLM provider and model to use for a consolidation batch, falling back to the account default when not explicitly overridden.

nodes.name: resolve_provider
nodes.summary: Maps a resolved model/account_id pair to a concrete LLM provider instance.

nodes.name: resolve_embed_mode
nodes.summary: Probes the embedding provider once per batch to decide whether candidate recall should use embedding similarity (Mode A) or manifest ranking (Mode B).

nodes.name: BatchContext
nodes.summary: Groups the resolved scope, provider, model, candidate mode, and embedding provider shared across every row processed in one consolidation batch.

nodes.name: BatchProviderInfo
nodes.summary: Holds the model and account_id resolved for a consolidation batch's LLM calls.

nodes.name: build_decision_prompt
nodes.summary: Constructs the mem0-style LLM prompt presenting a new fact and its candidate learnings, asking for an ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NONE decision as JSON.

nodes.name: levenshtein_capped
nodes.summary: Computes Levenshtein edit distance between two strings, short-circuiting once it exceeds a given cap for performance.

nodes.name: fuzzy_correct_id
nodes.summary: Corrects a possibly-hallucinated candidate ID returned by the LLM to the nearest real candidate ID using capped edit distance.

nodes.name: parse_decision
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's JSON decision response into a ResolvedDecision, applying fuzzy ID correction against the known candidate set.

nodes.name: DecisionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of the four possible mem0 consolidation decisions: Add, Update, Delete, or None.

nodes.name: RawDecision
nodes.summary: Deserialized shape of the raw JSON decision returned by the LLM before candidate-ID fuzzy correction.

nodes.name: ResolvedDecision
nodes.summary: Final decision after fuzzy ID correction, pairing a DecisionEvent with its resolved target learning ID and text.

nodes.name: consolidate
nodes.summary: Top-level consolidation entry point: loads pending learnings for a scope, groups them per billing account, resolves provider/embedding mode per group, drives consolidate_batch, and records a consolidation_runs row.

nodes.name: apply_event
nodes.summary: Applies a resolved consolidation decision to the learnings store: promotes/adds on Add, merges on Update, deprecates on Delete, or abandons on None, tallying EventCounts.

nodes.name: EventCounts
nodes.summary: Tallies of how many learnings were added, updated, deleted, left unchanged, or abandoned during a consolidation batch.

nodes.name: recall_mode_embedding
nodes.summary: Embeds the new fact and runs a vector similarity search over active learnings to shortlist consolidation candidates (Mode A).

nodes.name: recall_mode_manifest
nodes.summary: Shortlists consolidation candidates without embeddings by loading active learnings and ranking them by salience score (Mode B).

nodes.name: setup_conn
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory SQLite connection with the session/learnings schema initialized for use in consolidation unit tests.

nodes.name: pending
nodes.summary: Builds a PendingLearning test fixture with a computed content hash for a given scope and content string.

nodes.name: spawn_consolidation_tick
nodes.summary: Starts the background consolidation thread exactly once (guarded by an AtomicBool), giving it its own single-threaded Tokio runtime.

nodes.name: run_tick
nodes.summary: Evaluates forced/idle triggers and drives consolidation across all eligible scopes for a single scheduler tick.

nodes.name: select_trigger
nodes.summary: Picks which ConsolidationTrigger applies for a scope given forced/idle/lazy-ready flags.

nodes.name: drive_scopes
nodes.summary: Iterates all known scopes, checking lazy trigger readiness (or forced/idle overrides) and invoking consolidate() for each eligible one.

nodes.name: lazy_trigger_ready
nodes.summary: Returns true when a scope has enough pending learnings and enough elapsed time since the last consolidation to justify a lazy trigger.

nodes.name: forced_trigger_ready
nodes.summary: Returns true whenever there is at least one pending learning anywhere, used for manually forced consolidation.

nodes.name: idle_trigger_ready
nodes.summary: Returns true when the system has been idle long enough (no recent session activity) to justify running consolidation in the background.

nodes.name: is_e2e_learnings_test_scope
nodes.summary: Identifies scopes reserved for end-to-end learnings tests so production trigger policy can special-case them.
